mechanism: Torsemide-induced electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) may increase caspofungin nephrotoxicity and reduce cardiac stability; caspofungin may cause acute kidney injury compounding loop diuretic-related renal effects.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes, renal function, and urine output closely; consider potassium and magnesium supplementation; adjust diuretic dosing if significant renal impairment develops.
